name: Postal Address 6
definition: Information that locates and identifies a specific address, as defined by postal services.

AddressType.name: Address Type
AddressType.definition: Identifies the nature of the postal address.

Department.name: Department
Department.definition: Identification of a division of a large organisation or building.

SubDepartment.name: Sub Department
SubDepartment.definition: Identification of a sub-division of a large organisation or building.

StreetName.name: Street Name
StreetName.definition: Name of a street or thoroughfare.

BuildingNumber.name: Building Number
BuildingNumber.definition: Number that identifies the position of a building on a street.

PostCode.name: Post Code
PostCode.definition: Identifier consisting of a group of letters and/or numbers that is added to a postal address to assist the sorting of mail.

TownName.name: Town Name
TownName.definition: Name of a built-up area, with defined boundaries, and a local government.

CountrySubDivision.name: Country Sub Division
CountrySubDivision.definition: Identifies a subdivision of a country such as state, region, county.

AddressLine.name: Address Line
AddressLine.definition: Information that locates and identifies a specific address, as defined by postal services, presented in free format text.
